text:
maria_cs_ops: FYI — we're seeing a burst of false 'at-risk' signals from the onboarding webhook delay. I gated the auto-nudge playbook for cohorts created in the last 48h. Please don't run any broad backfills yet.

lucas_product: ugh. do we know root cause? is it the webhook or the scorer?

anya_data: looking at the pipeline: onboarding_events ingestion had a 45m lag between 02:10-02:55 UTC. A handful of accounts got duplicate 'first_success' events which pushed them into LOW_ENGAGEMENT for a minute.

sam_sre: confirmed ingress backlog on consumer-group cs-onboard-consumer. Consumer restarted at 03:02 UTC and lag drained. I'm attaching the tail of the consumer logs: 
```
[03:00:12] WARN: Kafka partition 7 lag 120k msgs
[03:01:58] INFO: restarting consumer cs-onboard-consumer
[03:02:59] INFO: lag 0
```

maria_cs_ops: thanks. duplicates are the issue then. Any accounts mis-scored persistently?

anya_data: most corrected themselves after lag drained, but ~2.1k accounts had a short-lived flag flip. They were picked up by playbook-runner during the window.

devon_cs: is there an easy rollback? we already saw a few automated nudges go out (email / in-app). Need to triage renewal risk alerts too.

sam_sre: playbook-runner has a dry-run toggle and an immediate suppression endpoint. I issued a suppression for the time window and cohorts: `POST /internal/playbook/suppress` body `{ "start_ts": 1825002000, "end_ts": 1825003200, "tags": ["onboard", "auto-nudge"] }`

maria_cs_ops: perfect. can we get a list of recipients who already got nudges so support can flag outreach?

anya_data: querying now. sample SQL I ran: 
```sql
SELECT account_id, email, sent_at FROM outbound_events
WHERE event_type = 'onboard_nudge'
AND sent_at BETWEEN to_timestamp(1825002000) AND to_timestamp(1825003200)
AND cohort = 'new_accounts_48h';
```
Will paste CSV in #cs-ops-asana in a sec.

lucas_product: we should add a debounce window in the scorer: ignore rapid state toggles within 10 minutes. That'll prevent transient flips from triggering playbooks.

anya_data: Agreed. I'll propose a quick fix: state_ttl debounce param default 10m. I'll open a PR against cs-scoring with tests.

devon_cs: for immediate ops: can we tag those accounts with `suppress_auto_nudge` so further automation ignores them until we validate?

sam_sre: suppression endpoint supports metadata. I added `meta: { "reason": "consumer-lag-dup-event", "owner": "maria_cs_ops" }`. Also set tag `suppress_auto_nudge` on 2,134 accounts.

maria_cs_ops: amazing. next steps: anya to PR debounce + monitor, lucas to update playbook policy to respect debounce flag, devon to coordinate CS outreach for flagged recipients, sam to add alert for consumer lag > 5m. I'll summarize in a follow-up doc.

playbook-runner-bot: suppression applied (id=sb-20260323-001). Playbook runs paused for cohorts: new_accounts_48h, trial_starters_7d.

lucas_product: also can we add a soft-fail mode on playbook-runner: when scoring source unstable, route to canary channel not live automations?

maria_cs_ops: yes, add as roadmap item. For this incident let's keep the stopgap actions.

anya_data: PR opened: https://git.internal/redwood/cs-scoring/pulls/128 — debounce param + unit tests. I'll monitor staging after deploy.

sam_sre: added alerting runbook: if cs-onboard-consumer lag > 30k msgs for >10m, page oncall and auto-suppress new playbook runs.

devon_cs: I'll draft CS outreach template to acknowledge accidental nudges and provide a short FAQ. Posting to #cs-ops-asana by EOD.

maria_cs_ops: thanks team. no more broad backfills until PR lands and we validate. Will follow up with the CSV and a short incident note. :white_check_mark:
